head: 3a1589ba490b432ceeca2f098e458f0af5a0d8d7
environment: Linux sandbox phone-agent; vendored OpenJDK 21 via the host's solr-gradle.sh runner in place of ./gradlew; existing full clone fetched to the exact PR head and verified clean before the run (fresh clones currently fail on this host with a disk quota error); Gradle invocation serialized under the host test-queue flock.

changes: schema-docValuesSkipList.xml: added the _version_ field exactly as the setup correction record specifies, before uniqueKey.
DocValuesSkipListTest.beforeTests: set solr.index.updatelog.enabled=true and switched initCore to solrconfig.xml with schema-docValuesSkipList.xml.

DocValuesSkipListTest: added testAtomicUpdateWithSkipIndexedDocValues, which first asserts the schema exposes an in-place-capable _version_ field, indexes the control (id 1, long_plain=10) and target (id 2, longdv=10), commits, applies the control atomic inc and asserts value 11, then applies the target atomic inc and asserts value 11.

Document ids are numeric (1 and 2) rather than the assignment's role names, because the schema's id field parses values numerically under the test randomization; run 1 with string ids failed at indexing and was classified as a setup failure (see runs-note.txt in the evidence archive).

results.control: The long_plain atomic inc succeeded and the value read back as 11; the test passed the control update (line 161) and its assertions before reaching the target update.
results.target: The longdv atomic inc failed at DocValuesSkipListTest.java:171 with SolrException: Exception writing document id 2 to the index, caused by java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: Can't update [NUMERIC] doc values; the field [longdv] must be doc values only field, bit it has doc values skip index (Lucene's DocValues update validation, verbatim including its wording).
results.classification: Reproduced under the gate's criteria: the control update succeeded and returned 11, and the target update failed in the Lucene DocValues-update guard because longdv has a RANGE skip index. The guard firing on the DocValues update path, with _version_ present and the update log enabled, also confirms the in-place path was the one exercised.

run_history: Run 1 failed on the string-id setup issue and is recorded as incomplete in runs-note.txt; run 2 was killed by a sandbox service restart before the test executed and was not counted; run 3 is the decisive run reported here.
